html:
Duration: 2 hours
Temperature: -17 celsius
Objects observed: Orion Nebula, Saturn, Mars, Horsehead Nebula
Mount: Alt-Az
Location: Grand-Mère

Another observing session devoted to perfecting the art of focusing a DSLR at the focus of the telescope. It's not easy. Also, I now think the poor collimation of the LX90 is a serious limitation.

Since my observing spot is less than 200 m from the Laurentide mill in Grand-Mère, I'm often forced to interrupt the observation because of the clouds coming out of the smokestacks.

Here are two photos showing my "setup" for taking the images published so far


Right at the bottom of the steps!!! ;-) ready in 5 minutes.


Here you can clearly see the camera attached to the telescope.
